name: Trata
description:
Connect your AI assistant directly to Trata — the fastest-growing library of investment research, centered on anonymous hedge fund debate.

With Trata MCP, your assistant will have the tools to reason across hundreds of calls in our library. It goes beyond simple searches to help breakdown bull and bear cases, compare analyst sentiment across time, and deep dive into stock analysis. We compress what would take hours of analyst research into a single question.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.trata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trata provides these MCP tools: list_coverage, list_transcripts, search_transcripts, and search_within_transcript.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trata in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Trata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trata is developed by Trata. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
